data.name: Manaafit
data.gender_notes: Manaafit is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anafa, meaning 'to support, to help, or to carry a burden'. This name is often used for those who are strong and steadfast in their support for their loved ones and their faith. The name Manaafit carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manaafit usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carry the weight of others' burdens in faith and love.
data.etymology: Manaafit belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manaafit total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: منافيت
in_arabic.meaning: منافقة و نفاق کے معنی میں
in_arabic.long_meaning: منافيت کا تعلق عربی جڑ منافق سے ہے، جو منافقین کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنی زبان میں کچھ چھپاتے ہیں اور اپنے دل میں کچھ رکھتے ہیں۔ قرآن میں منافقین کے بارے میں سورت البقرة میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ منافقت سے بچنے کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: منافیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: منافیت عربی جڑ منافق سے نکلا ہے، جو ان لوگوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو ظاہراً کچھ کہتے ہیں لیکن اپنے دل میں کچھ چھپاتے ہیں۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، منافقین کو قرآن کریم میں سورت البقرة میں مذمت کا نشانہ بنایا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جو منافقت سے بچنے کی تاکید کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मनाफित
in_hindi.long_meaning: मनाफित नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'منافق' से हुई है, जो उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने मुंह में कुछ और छुपाते हैं और अपने दिल में कुछ और। इस्लामी परंपरा में, मनाफिकों की निंदा कुरआन में सूरा अल-बक़रा में की गई है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, जो पाखंड से बचने की याद दिलाता है।

in_english.name: Manaafit
in_english.long_meaning: The name Manaafit originates from the Arabic root 'منافق' (manafiq), which refers to individuals who outwardly express something but conceal another thing in their hearts. In Islamic tradition, such individuals are condemned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah. The name holds spiritual significance across Muslim cultures, emphasizing the importance of sincerity and warning against hypocrisy. It symbolizes the need for believers to be truthful and pure in their intentions and actions.

These attributes reflect the qualities of steadfastness, purity, and generosity, which are embodied in the name Manaafit. It also reminds the bearer of their role as a representative of Allah in this world and to strive to be a source of benefit and support for others, following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
